Canonical research core · lean

Abstract conditional composition interface

Composes supplied stage-correctness implications for arbitrary carriers and predicates. The winning-move conclusion is conditional on that interface and an exact initial state; the cost theorem projects an assumed inequality.

Lean verified (stated scope)

Verification applies only to the recorded source snapshot and check scope. Consult the coverage report for build and axiom-check details.

Scientific review

Review verdict: passed. Evidence and exact scope are linked above.

Hypotheses and scope

  • Eight arbitrary carrier types; all functions and correctness predicates supplied in EndToEndInvariantPortfolio; an initial StateExact hypothesis. stepCostWithinLogBudget is assumed and logBudget is arbitrary.

Formalization correspondence

The theorem expands stage definitions and applies portfolio fields in sequence. StateExact can be identically false, so no inhabited exact state is established. WinningMove can be any predicate, so the result alone is not actual Chomp correctness. Functions may consult arbitrary data. The cost conclusion follows directly from its field and has no mathematical logarithm requirement. Documentation was corrected without changing code tokens.

Verification evidence

This corrected source snapshot passed a new clean strict build, exhaustive serialized and elaborated declaration/axiom census, and five fresh Lean kernel replays. Exact source/type correspondence and unchanged logical declarations after the documented comment corrections were checked separately. Only the standard propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound axioms were observed. Module and compiler-declaration counts are not counts of independent mathematical theorems.

Formal declarations

These are exact elaborated statement types from the full kernel audit, including private and generated declarations. Generated helper statements are not separate mathematical results.
